_about: Public-domain S. P. Tregelles (Samuel Prideaux Tregelles, 1813-1875, textual critic, sometime Brethren) for the Word Hoard: 5 books from Internet Archive scans, 1847-1854: Remarks on the Prophetic Visions in the Book of Daniel (first edition, 1847), The Jansenists (1851), A Lecture on the Historic Evidence of the Authorship and Transmission of the Books of the New Testament (1852), Defence of the Authenticity of the Book of Daniel and An Account of the Printed Text of the Greek New Testament (1854). Raw OCR. His editions of texts and his Hebrew aids are left as alternates. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
